@Bettina Kroll, I saved a draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup." It's in your mailbox and hasn't been sent.

It's built from Sofia's bullets plus your mapping: Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments, and Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. I wrote it fresh rather than editing Sofia's draft, because I can't edit existing drafts. Her earlier draft to June, which has the line about coverage notes I shouldn't have added, is still in her mailbox. She may want to delete it so June doesn't get two versions.
